commands: RUN_ID="local-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-1"; echo "RUN_ID=$RUN_ID"; mkdir -p ".prflow/tmp/review/pr-1719/$RUN_ID"; gh pr diff 1719 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee ".prflow/tmp/review/pr-1719/$RUN_ID/diff.patch" | head -5; echo "---DIFFSTAT---"; wc -l ".prflow/tmp/review/pr-1719/$RUN_ID/diff.patch"; echo "$RUN_ID" > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1719/current-run-id.txt

echo "=== 1. Consumer search for retired literals across machine-consumer surface (scripts/, lib/ excl lib/test, .github/) ==="
for needle in 'no-subagent, all-inline model' '(vi)' 'within the existing automatic audit budget' 'not a fourth defect class' 'legibility-only' 'module or path' 'focused path'; do
  echo "--- needle: [$needle] ---"
  grep -rIl -- "$needle" scripts/ lib/ .github/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^lib/test/' || echo "  (no machine-consumer hits)"
done

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
